answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48494 Country: India Title: Meaning of Name Question: Could you please tell me meaning of my name "Naim Ahmed"? Answer ID: 48494 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1491/1151/B=11/1434) Nayeem (نعيم) means: place of pleasure. Jannah is also called Nayeem. It is good name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
